acs: DERIVED: Applicant without the editor role can return home from the permission denied page - features/permission-boundaries/permission-boundaries.feature:27

steps.action: Log in to D2R2 as an SSO user using the current Windows session
steps.expected: The D2R2 Home page is displayed

steps.action: Open the Maintain global users page by typing its address in the browser
steps.expected: The "You do not have permission to view this page" message is displayed

steps.action: Click the Go to the D2R2 home page link
steps.expected: The D2R2 Home page is displayed

steps.action: Check the home page content
steps.expected: The popular links are visible

steps.action: Check the page for error messages
steps.expected: No "An error has occurred" heading or error message is displayed

test_cases.title: Applicant without the editor role is not offered editor links on the home page
acs: DERIVED: Applicant without the editor role is not offered editor links on the home page - features/permission-boundaries/permission-boundaries.feature:33

steps.action: Log in to D2R2 as an SSO user using the current Windows session
steps.expected: The D2R2 Home page is displayed

steps.action: Open the D2R2 Home page
steps.expected: The Home page is displayed with the D2R2 menu

steps.action: Check the Home page and the main menu
steps.expected: None of these links are displayed: Compare profile versions, Create disease ranking filter, Create profile, Review timings, Maintain species data, Maintain reference data, Maintain global users, Maintain external users, Maintain prioritisation variables, Maintain cross-cutting issue scores, Edit questions and guidance

steps.action: Check the page for error messages
steps.expected: No "An error has occurred" heading or error message is displayed

steps.action: Check the page heading
steps.expected: The page heading is visible
